quill.default: quill: Captain. Forgive me, I'm in the middle of a count. Forty-one... forty-two...
quill.rats_brief: quill: Captain. Thank you for coming. It's the hold stores. Something has been at them.
quill[concerned]: Eleven biscuits. Two sacks of peas. A wheel of cheese I was saving for your birthday.
captain[annoyed]: My birthday was in March.
quill: It was a very patient cheese, sir. Was.
quill: Rats, Captain. In the cargo hold. Jory's seen them, bold as brass, and one of them the size of a dog.
quill[concerned]: The crew won't go down. Well, they will, but they come back with less biscuit and more bites.
quill: I'd be grateful if you dealt with it. Personally. It sends a message.
quill: Bandages from the stores, signed for. The stairs down to the hold are just there, by the aft bulkhead.
quill.rats_reminder: quill: Any luck below, Captain? I've been counting the biscuits again. I wish I hadn't.

then: quill[concerned]: Jory reckons three nests. Three. I've started a separate ledger just for rats.

quill.rats_report: quill: Captain! You're back. And you're...
quill[happy]: Then the hold is clear! I'll amend the ledger at once.
quill: 'Stores secured. Losses: eleven biscuits, two sacks of peas, one cheese, and approximately six rats.'
quill: The company thanks you. The company being, technically, you.
quill: Something from the stores for your trouble. And this, which Jory made from... well. You'll see.
quill[happy]: The ship's stores are open again, too. Everything in order. Everything accounted for.
quill[concerned]: ...Except the doubloon you borrowed for luck in March, sir. But I'm sure that's in hand.

start: quill: Ship's stores, Captain. Fair prices. They're fair because I set them.

then: quill[happy]: Balanced, sir. For the first time in a month. I may frame this page.
